description: Splits the clip under the given timeline position into two on every track that has one there (the GUI's Split command). Fails with nothing_to_split when no clip spans the position.

at.description: Timeline position to split at, e.g. 23 for bar 23

project.description: Path to the .audium project package (absolute paths recommended)

unit.description: Unit for positions (default bars; bars/beats are 1-based, seconds/clocks absolute)

name: split
title: Split clips
